svg.title: What I build and what I do off the keyboard
svg.desc: Capabilities: RAG pipelines, local AI automation, full-stack web apps, data and backend work. A carousel cycles through video editing, anime and manga, and badminton every four seconds.

g.text: Retrieval over vector databases for grounded answers.
Ollama-powered models that run on your own machine.
FastAPI and Flask backends, responsive interfaces.
Python, SQL, SQLite, NumPy and Pandas.
Panels, arcs and worlds worth revisiting.
